name: TEC the Tractor
overview: TEC the Tractor loves helping out at Family Farm with his friends Tommy the Trailer, Carolyn the Cow and all the farm animals and machines that live with them. But TEC seems to always get himself into some sort of trouble. Luckily, the farmer and other farm animals and machines always arrive just in time to save the day. In these children videos, kids will share adventures with this cute model tractor and the live-action farmyard setting of the series, based on a popular children’s book.
